name: @appstrate/coolify-mcp
description: Coolify integration backed by the MCP server built into Coolify ({instance}/mcp). Coolify is self-hosted, so the instance URL is a connection variable with no default: one package serves every instance and each connection reaches only its own. The sidecar opens a Streamable HTTP MCP client and injects a team API token as `Authorization: Bearer …` — Coolify's MCP accepts no OAuth. Every tool is scoped to the token's team, and the token's permissions bound what an agent can do: `read` serves the inventory and status tools, `read:sensitive` adds `get_logs` and deployment log summaries, `deploy` adds the lifecycle tools (`deploy`, `cancel_deployment`, `control` — start, stop, restart). Environment variable values, configuration snapshots and full deployment logs are never returned. The MCP server is off by default: an instance administrator turns it on, and a team can turn it off for itself. The tool set grows with each Coolify release, so the catalogue below is the current one and `allow_undeclared_tools` lets an agent take whatever its instance advertises.

base_url.title: URL de l'instance Coolify
base_url.description: Adresse de votre tableau de bord Coolify, sans chemin (ex. https://coolify.example.com). Un administrateur de l'instance doit avoir activé le serveur MCP (Settings → Advanced), et votre équipe ne doit pas l'avoir désactivé.

token.title: Jeton d'API
token.description: Jeton créé dans Keys & Tokens → API Tokens, pour l'équipe dont l'agent doit voir les ressources, collé tel qu'affiché (identifiant, « | », secret). Permission read pour consulter ; ajoutez read:sensitive pour lire les logs et deploy pour déployer, démarrer, arrêter ou redémarrer.
